sources.title: Gemma 4 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's new family of open models, including 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B, and 31B. The multimodal, hybrid-thinking models support 140+ languages, up to 256K context, and have dense and MoE variants.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Fine-tuning Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: You can now train Google's Gemma 4 12B, E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B and 31B with Unsloth. Unsloth supports all vision, text, audio and RL fine-tuning for Gemma 4.

sources.title: How to run Gemma 4 locally with Unsloth AI - Wolfeast
sources.snippet: Unsloth Studio is a local web UI that wraps llama.cpp with a chat interface, auto-sets inference parameters, and handles model downloads. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. If you've never run a local model before, start here. Unsloth Studio's model selector showing Gemma 4 E4B quantization options.
